Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are very excited about the opportunity to work together with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and to prove ourselves as a reliable partner for your business!

For our offer, we can propose a price of €47.00 per unit, alongside a quality commitment of 6400 ppm. 

Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days. We are eager to show you what we can do and hope this initial quote meets your expectations. Let us know if you have any questions at all.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

move.subject: Re: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
move.body:
Dear Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o. team,

You emphasise proving reliability, yet your proposed quality commitment is looser than your recorded performance—it seems the commitment needs to better reflect the partnership you want to build. We want lasting cooperation founded on defect prevention and clear accountability rather than punitive complaint costs. What corrective-action report can you provide to substantiate a binding quality commitment that improves on your recorded performance?

We confirm a binding volume of 15,900 units per year for 12 months. Your quality over the last 12 months was 2376 ppm (sc:70140@2026Q3). Producer prices DE: basic iron and steel, ferro-alloys changed -4.3% from 2024-10 to 2025-10 (idx:PPI-C241@2024-10, idx:PPI-C241@2025-10). Our demand forecast for Bearing bracket HN is up +20.0% (fc:310020@2026-09). We understand cash flow matters to you: we will pay every invoice reliably on the agreed day. Please send us your 8D report and a binding ppm commitment.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (300 ppm, EUR 0 per complaint, EUR 42.77 per unit). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Hello,
many thanks, good to have your reply!
we can move a bit:
Our terms: a price of €46.00 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint.
Please let me explain.
We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We see your figures, but we cannot give up margin right now. Faster payment would help us more than anything.
We can offer a binding commitment of 2500 ppm, which reflects our actual performance, but 300 ppm is too strict for us right now.
We can reduce the price to 45.50 EUR per unit to account for the volume and index changes you mentioned.
You talked about paying reliably on the agreed day; this is very important to us because we have experienced late payments, and we need to rely on strict on-time payments.
Alternatively, with a quality commitment of 2500 ppm: €45.50 per unit.
Our standard Zahlungsziel is 60 days net.
Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price.
We are ready when you are!
Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

We confirm a binding volume of 15,900 units per year for 12 months. Producer prices DE: electric power generation, transmission and distribution changed -17.1% from 2025-02 to 2026-02 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-02, idx:PPI-D351@2026-02). That is on us, and it ends with this contract: every invoice paid on the due date, which brings your cash in about 10 days earlier than you are used to.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (300 ppm, EUR 0 per complaint, EUR 43.57 per unit). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke
